mapper.select: SELECT skill_id AS skillId, owner_type AS ownerType, owner_id AS ownerId, skill_key AS skillKey, name, description, resource_costs::text AS resourceCostsJson, cooldowns::text AS cooldownsJson, mechanics_config::text AS mechanicsConfigJson FROM public.skills WHERE game_id = #{gameId} ORDER BY skill_id

SELECT skill_id AS skillId, owner_type AS ownerType, owner_id AS ownerId, skill_key AS skillKey, name, description, resource_costs::text AS resourceCostsJson, cooldowns::text AS cooldownsJson, mechanics_config::text AS mechanicsConfigJson FROM public.skills WHERE game_id = #{gameId} AND skill_id = #{skillId}

SELECT skill_id AS skillId, owner_type AS ownerType, owner_id AS ownerId, skill_key AS skillKey, name, description, resource_costs::text AS resourceCostsJson, cooldowns::text AS cooldownsJson, mechanics_config::text AS mechanicsConfigJson FROM public.skills WHERE game_id = #{gameId} AND updated_at > #{updatedAfter} ORDER BY skill_id
mapper.update: INSERT INTO public.skills (game_id, skill_id, start_version_id, end_version_id, owner_id, owner_type, skill_key, name, description, resource_costs, cooldowns, mechanics_config, updated_at) VALUES (#{gameId}, #{skillId}, #{versionId}, #{versionId}, #{ownerId}, #{ownerType}, #{skillKey}, #{name}, #{description}, CAST(#{resourceCostsJson} AS jsonb), CAST(#{cooldownsJson} AS jsonb), CAST(#{mechanicsConfigJson} AS jsonb), NOW()) ON CONFLICT (game_id, skill_id) DO UPDATE SET start_version_id = EXCLUDED.start_version_id, end_version_id = EXCLUDED.end_version_id, owner_id = EXCLUDED.owner_id, owner_type = EXCLUDED.owner_type, skill_key = EXCLUDED.skill_key, name = EXCLUDED.name, description = EXCLUDED.description, resource_costs = EXCLUDED.resource_costs, cooldowns = EXCLUDED.cooldowns, mechanics_config = EXCLUDED.mechanics_config, updated_at = NOW()

INSERT INTO public.skills_log (game_id, skill_id, start_version_id, end_version_id, owner_id, owner_type, skill_key, name, description, resource_costs, cooldowns, mechanics_config) VALUES (#{gameId}, #{skillId}, #{versionId}, #{versionId}, #{ownerId}, #{ownerType}, #{skillKey}, #{name}, #{description}, CAST(#{resourceCostsJson} AS jsonb), CAST(#{cooldownsJson} AS jsonb), CAST(#{mechanicsConfigJson} AS jsonb)) ON CONFLICT (game_id, skill_id, start_version_id) DO UPDATE SET end_version_id = EXCLUDED.end_version_id, owner_id = EXCLUDED.owner_id, owner_type = EXCLUDED.owner_type, skill_key = EXCLUDED.skill_key, name = EXCLUDED.name, description = EXCLUDED.description, resource_costs = EXCLUDED.resource_costs, cooldowns = EXCLUDED.cooldowns, mechanics_config = EXCLUDED.mechanics_config
